context: Request: antitrust-practice matters where a deal went through a second request to clearance, with the clearance documents. Rubric: 1041-00001 (FTC second request, cleared January 2024; post-clearance status memo as the clearance record) required; 1003-00003 (DOJ second request, waiting period expired July 2025) also allowed by the precision criterion.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a count of files by extension.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Path regex over all files grouped by matter (183 matters, about 155K characters), a grep on *.docx that returns nothing, and per-matter counts. The review flags the broad terms and the six-matter shortlist.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Attempt 2: narrower path regex for request words; 58 matters.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Attempt 3: wider regex adding agency, filing and divestiture words; 100 matters. The review flags the truncated output and that no content search was run.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: A store-wide extraction script and a range rerun both time out; a script over 15 named candidates and a grep of its saved output for document names. The review flags the timeouts and the hand-picked list.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads strategy memos, compliance letters, trackers and closing records of five candidates, then later sections and trackers of the leads. The review flags unopened surfaced matters and that no agency letter was opened.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists all files of six candidates.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes two matters as qualifying, with their closing records and exclusions.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Re-reads the response and five cited sources; edits the headline scope and the cited-document descriptions.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Attempt 2: re-reads the full response.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file names for request keywords → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → List files in candidate matters → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script times out; a range rerun over the saved candidates prints term labels per matter. The review flags the candidate-only scope and noisy terms.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Attempt 2: store-wide co-occurrence scan in matter ranges, then a grep of its output for three matters. The review flags the hand-picked follow-up.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Attempt 3: tighter regex over the saved scan output, grouped into 18 matters.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth (attempt 2). Lists six matters, then reads one tracker of a chosen matter and one document from each of four excluded candidates. The review flags claims not backed by reads in the stage.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Attempt 3: re-reads the key documents of both chosen matters.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Attempt 4: reads one closing certificate twice. The review flags that the documents the request asks for were not obtained.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Attempt 5: reads four regulatory documents of one chosen matter.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Attempt 6: reads a memo opening, lists the matter's files and re-reads a certificate. The review names two listed files not opened.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Attempt 7: reads those two files.

divergence: All pass. Shared procedure: file-name searches for request words surfaced the matter early. A timed-out store-wide scan was rerun on candidates or in batches. Reading the leads' compliance letters and status or closing records confirmed both matters, and near-miss candidates were excluded after one read each.
